<content>
1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return; // canvas not found
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6: 
7:   // set canvas size to fill its container or window
8:   const resize = () => {
9:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
10:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
11:     generateStars();
12:   };
13:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
14:   resize();
15:   // initial starfield
16:   generateStars();
17: 
18:   // --- Sound setup ---
19:   const bgMusic = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mdn/webaudio-examples/beatbox.mp3');
20:   bgMusic.loop = true;
21:   bgMusic.volume = 0.2;
22:   const crashSound = new Audio('https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mdn/webaudio-examples/audio/alert.wav');
23:   let soundStarted = false;
24:   const startSounds = () => {
25:     if (!soundStarted) {
26:       bgMusic.play();
27:       soundStarted = true;
28:     }
29:   };
30:   window.addEventListener('keydown', startSounds);
31: 
32: 
33:   // Player ship (simple triangle)
34:   const player = {
35:     x: canvas.width / 2,
36:     y: canvas.height - 60,
37:     size: 30,
38:     speed: 5,
39:   };
40: 
41:   const keys = {};
42:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
43:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
44: 
45:   // Asteroids
46:   const asteroids = [];
47:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
48:   let lastSpawn = 0;
49: 
50:   let startTime = performance.now();
51:   let gameOver = false;
52: 
53:   const drawPlayer = () => {
54:     // ship with glow effect
55:     ctx.save();
56:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0f0';
57:     ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
58:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
59:     ctx.beginPath();
60:     ctx.moveTo(player.x, player.y - player.size / 2);
61:     ctx.lineTo(player.x - player.size / 2, player.y + player.size / 2);
62:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.size / 2, player.y + player.size / 2);
63:     ctx.closePath();
64:     ctx.fill();
65:     ctx.restore();
66:   };
67: 
68:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
69:     const radius = Math.random() * 15 + 10;
70:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - 2 * radius) + radius;
71:     const speed = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
72:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed });
73:   };
74: 
75:   const updateAsteroids = (delta) => {
76:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
77:       const a = asteroids[i];
78:       a.y += a.speed * delta * 0.06; // adjust speed factor
79:       if (a.y - a.radius > canvas.height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
80:     }
81:   };
82: 
83:   const drawAsteroids = () => {
84:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
85:       // radial gradient for depth effect
86:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
87:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff9966'); // bright core
88:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#663300'); // dark edge
89:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
90:       ctx.beginPath();
91:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
92:       ctx.fill();
93:     });
94:   };
95: 
96:   const rectCircleCollide = (rect, circle) => {
97:     const distX = Math.abs(circle.x - rect.x);
98:     const distY = Math.abs(circle.y - rect.y);
99:     if (distX > (rect.w / 2 + circle.r)) return false;
100:     if (distY > (rect.h / 2 + circle.r)) return false;
101:     if (distX <= (rect.w / 2)) return true;
102:     if (distY <= (rect.h / 2)) return true;
103:     const dx = distX - rect.w / 2;
104:     const dy = distY - rect.h / 2;
105:     return (dx * dx + dy * dy <= (circle.r * circle.r));
106:   };
107: 
108:   const checkCollisions = () => {
109:     const shipRect = { x: player.x, y: player.y, w: player.size, h: player.size, r: 0 };
110:     for (const a of asteroids) {
111:       if (rectCircleCollide(shipRect, { x: a.x, y: a.y, r: a.radius })) {
112:         gameOver = true;
113:         // play crash sound and stop background music
114:         crashSound.currentTime = 0;
115:         crashSound.play();
116:         bgMusic.pause();
117:         break;
118:       }
119:     }
120:   };
121: 
122:   const drawScore = () => {
123:     const elapsed = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000);
124:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
125:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
126:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${elapsed}s`, 10, 30);
127:   };
128: 
129:   const loop = (timestamp) => {
130:     if (gameOver) {
131:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
132:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
133:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
134:       ctx.font = '40px sans-serif';
135:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 100, canvas.height / 2);
136:       return;
137:     }
138:     const delta = timestamp - (lastRender || timestamp);
139:     lastRender = timestamp;
140:     // draw background first
141:     drawBackground();
142:     // clear any leftover (background already fills)
143:     // ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
144: 
145:     // player movement
146:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] && player.x - player.size / 2 > 0) player.x -= player.speed;
147:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] && player.x + player.size / 2 < canvas.width) player.x += player.speed;
148:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && player.y - player.size / 2 > 0) player.y -= player.speed;
149:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] && player.y + player.size / 2 < canvas.height) player.y += player.speed;
150: 
151:     // spawn asteroids
152:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
153:       spawnAsteroid();
154:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
155:     }
156: 
157:     updateAsteroids(delta);
158:     checkCollisions();
159:     drawAsteroids();
160:     drawPlayer();
161:     drawScore();
162: 
163:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
164:   };
165:   let lastRender = null;
166:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
167: })();

(End of file - total 167 lines)
</content>
